verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents several ways to operate it in natural language. Users can describe what they want in chat and the product builds the agent or automation (docs-18, docs-19, docs-8). Agents can be edited by describing a change (docs-29). A built-in MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or other MCP clients build flows, manage tables and test automations through natural language (docs-4, docs-27, probe-4). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works reliably across the whole platform.
